what_happened.line: A motion to sign the special Town Meeting warrant as presented was made; the result is not audible in the recording.
The board reviewed the warrant, including a deed-in-lieu article for conservation land and a proposal to move stormwater provisions from zoning to the general bylaws.
The stormwater move raised concerns and was referred to town counsel for more information.
A motion to ratify the town manager's appointment of a Council on Aging outreach coordinator was made; the result is not audible.
The citizen petition moratorium stays as article 11, and the November 7 meeting will start at 6:30.

why_it_matters: The warrant lists the articles voters will be asked to act on at the special Town Meeting, so the deed-in-lieu article and the stormwater bylaw move shape what residents decide there.
Moving stormwater rules from zoning to the general bylaws can change which vote threshold and which process apply to them, which is why town counsel was asked to weigh in.
